variable.name: SCAN_CODE
variable.abstract: It contains the code of the key pressed in the last frame

description.p: This value is the predefined constant for the function . As the use of if the player has pressed two or more keys, the additional pulsations are saved in a small buffer to avoid their losses.
It is recommend tu use to check what key has been pressed, so it is more efficient and quick that check it manually using code in our program.
